001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.rulecmd;
002
003import java.util.List;
004import java.util.Map;
005
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.FactionAPI;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.InteractionDialogAPI;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.comm.IntelInfoPlugin;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.rules.MemoryAPI;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.characters.PersonAPI;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.People;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.contacts.ContactIntel;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.contacts.ContactIntel.ContactState;
015import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc.Token;
016
017/**
018 * HasContactFromFaction $factionId
019 */
020public class HasContactFromFaction extends BaseCommandPlugin {
021
022        
023        public boolean execute(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
024                
025                String id = params.get(0).getString(memoryMap);
026                FactionAPI faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(id);
027                Boolean useVIPBlacklist = false;
028                
029                // Sometimes we just want a "normal" contact, not a major character who can incidentally become a contact.
030                if (params.size() > 1) {
031                        useVIPBlacklist = params.get(1).getBoolean(memoryMap);
032                }
033                
034                for (IntelInfoPlugin intel : Global.getSector().getIntelManager().getIntel(ContactIntel.class)) {
035                        ContactState state = ((ContactIntel)intel).getState();
036                        if (state != ContactState.NON_PRIORITY && state != ContactState.PRIORITY) continue;
037                        PersonAPI person = ((ContactIntel)intel).getPerson();
038                        if (person == null) continue;
039                        if (useVIPBlacklist && 
040                                        (       person.getId().equals(People.REYNARD_HANNAN) || 
041                                                person.getId().equals(People.HORUS_YARIBAY) || 
042                                                person.getId().equals(People.ARROYO) || 
043                                                person.getId().equals(People.FARO_INESIS) || 
044                                                person.getId().equals(People.RAO) ||
045                                                person.getId().equals(People.GLAMOR_ROTANEV))) continue;
046                        if (person.getFaction() == faction) {
047                                return true;
048                        }
049                }
050
051                return false;
052                
053        }
054}
